query:
SELECT weekNumber, weekStartDate, campus, subgroup, headcount
FROM attendance_weekly 
WHERE year = 2026 AND weekNumber = 18
  AND subgroup IN ('Revolution Canton Check-In', 'Revolution Jasper Check-In', 'Kids')
ORDER BY campus, subgroup;
